{{Quote|This is Blackstar Squad, a special operations team. General Var Suthra pulled in a favor with General Garza. Got them here quick.|Special Agent Korol Tander|<ref name="Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
'''Blackstar Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] in the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Specializing in covert operations, the Blackstars undertook [[Mission to Hutta|missions]] in hostile environments such as [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] during the Cold War, and the squad was led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Donbar]] until [[Larin Moxla]] reported her superior's corruption in [[3643 BBY]]. Both Moxla and Donbar were dismissed from the [[Army/Legends|army]] as a result, though the squad itself remained in service. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]], the head of the Special Forces Division, later lent the Blackstars to General [[Var Suthra]] for a cover mission on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to repay a favor.

==History==
{{Quote|Ever been to Hutta before?''"<br />"''No. Not the surface.''"<br />"''It's vile and dangerous. I was there on a covert op two years ago. Very nearly didn't get out again.|Larin Moxla and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]]|<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />}}
A [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Army]], Blackstar Squad was formed sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3645 BBY]]. That year, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Blackstars were deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the neutral criminal syndicate known as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], on a [[Mission to Hutta|covert mission]]. Another [[Blackstar Squad's urban mission|mission]] sent the squad into an urban guerrilla firefight that went bad when intelligence was leaked, and four members of the squad&mdash;including a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] named [[Larin Moxla]]&mdash;were caught in a trap. They managed to escape the fighting with only minor injuries, and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatments brought them back to full readiness. Moxla eventually decided to report her [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Donbar]]'s corruption in [[3643 BBY]] and Donbar was dismissed from service, but Moxla earned the nickname "Toxic Moxla" and was soon dismissed from the [[Army/Legends|army]] as well.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />

That same year, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was involved in a [[Desolator crisis|military crisis]] involving [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] stolen by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]. When he learned that Angral's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Sadic]] had [[Raid on the SIS safe house|wiped out]] the branch of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;that was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Suthra contacted the Special Forces' leader General [[Elin Garza]] for aid. Repaying a favor to the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] general, Garza dispatched the Blackstars to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in order to reinforce the [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who was pursuing Sadic and the stolen [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard supersoldier project]]. The Blackstars were placed under the command of SIS Special Agent [[Korol Tander]], who tailed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to [[Sadic's laboratory]] and brought the squad in to reinforce the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Showdown" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Finding that Sadic had already been [[Raid on Sadic's laboratory|defeated]], the squad followed the Knight's orders and destroyed the facility with explosives, permanently destroying the Power Guard project and ensuring that it would never be resurrected.<ref name="Showdown" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment and training==
{{Quote|You've done covert work?''"<br />"''More than I care to think about.|Konshi and Moxla|<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />}}
A Special Forces squad, the members of Blackstar Squad wore light combat armor of a dark grey [[Color/Legends|color]] with orange and white markings. The Blackstars also wore helmets with black visors and built-in [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], and carried [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] in combat.<ref name="Showdown" /> The squad was trained extensively in covert operations, extractions, [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]],<ref name="Fatal Alliance" /> and demolitions.<ref name="Showdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blackstar Squad was first introduced in [[Sean Williams]]' [[2008]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', the first in a [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (novel series)|series]] of tie-in novels for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" /> The squad's appearance in the Jedi Knight class mission "Showdown with Lord Sadic"<ref name="Showdown" /> marked one of the first times that content from ''Fatal Alliance'' was referenced in the rest of the ''The Old Republic'' metaseries, as the novel's characters and events have largely been ignored in the game and other material.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" /> Agent Tander identifies the commandos as Blackstar Squad, but the commando NPCs themselves are named "Black Star Commandos". The squad can be ordered to either destroy the Power Guard project for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points, copy the files for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points, or sabotage it for dark side points.<ref name="Showdown" /> However, as the Jedi Knight is a Republic class and is therefore assumed to make only the moral light side choices,<ref name="Light Side">It is assumed that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> this article assumes that the Power Guard project was destroyed.<ref name="Showdown" />
